sentences.en: Over the past few days, two of the lawyers who tried to help Donald Trump stay in power after losing the 2020 election pleaded guilty in a Georgia racketeering case
sentences.zh: 在过去几天里，两名试图帮助唐纳德·特朗普在2020年大选落败后继续窃取权力的律师，在佐治亚州的勒索敲诈案中认罪

sentences.en: and have agreed to cooperate with prosecutors against the former president.
sentences.zh: 并同意与检察官合作，指证这位前总统。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Richard Fawcett on why Trump's own advisors are now flipping.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事理查德·福赛特将为我们解析为什么特朗普自己的顾问现在会突然反水。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, October 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月24日，星期二。

sentences.en: Richard, of all the court cases against Donald Trump, and there are many of them, you told us from the start that the case filed against him in Georgia,
sentences.zh: 理查德，在针对唐纳德·特朗普的所有诉讼中——数量还真不少，你从一开始就告诉我们，在佐治亚州对他提起的那起诉讼

sentences.en: accusing him of trying to steal the 2020 election there, was extremely important, largely because of the nature of the prosecution.
sentences.zh: 指控他试图在那里窃取2020年大选，这极其重要，主要原因在于这起案件的指控性质。

sentences.en: It's a racketeering case that treats Trump as the leader of a criminal conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 这是一起将特朗普视为犯罪集团首脑的勒索敲诈案。

sentences.en: And the way that these cases work frequently is that in order to convict a person at the top of a case like this, you tend to need lower-level defendants, co-conspirators, to flip,
sentences.zh: 这类案件的运作方式通常是，为了给这种案件最高层的核心人物定罪，你往往需要低级别的被告和共同谋划者来反水

sentences.en: to turn on Trump.
sentences.zh: 来调转枪头对付特朗普。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this is what we wondered from the beginning, which of these 19 indicted co-conspirators might end up trying to make a deal, pleading guilty,

sentences.en: and agreeing to cooperate with prosecutors.

sentences.en: In fact, a former prosecutor here in Georgia once told us that, you know, imagine this multi-person racketeering conspiracy indictment that lists 19 people
sentences.zh: 事实上，佐治亚州的一位前检察官曾经告诉我们，你可以想象一下这份列出了19人的多方勒索共谋起诉书

sentences.en: and imagine it as a kind of carpet that you roll up from the bottom.
sentences.zh: 把它想象成一块从底部开始往上卷的地毯。

sentences.en: A lot of times, the most prominent figure in a racketeering indictment will be listed as what prosecutors actually sometimes call dude number one.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，勒索敲诈起诉书中最显眼的人物，往往会被检察官们有时称为“一号老兄”。

sentences.en: And imagine rolling up these smaller, lower-level participants in the alleged scheme who then produce a lot of pressure on the way up.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，把这个所谓阴谋中较小的、底层的参与者卷起来，这会在向上的过程中产生巨大的压力。

sentences.en: So there's always a question about who was going to participate, who was going to want to strike a deal, who was going to feel the pressure.
sentences.zh: 因此，总会有人提出这样的疑问：谁会参与进来？谁会想要达成协议？谁会感受到压力？

sentences.en: And we started to see an answer to that.
